name: New line - iPhone 17 Pro + Next Up Anytime (+$10/mo)
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: casual gadget fan, light humor.
scripted_messages: hey Tom here, i'm a gadget guy who gets antsy for new phones lol. planning one new line with an iPhone 17 Pro, no trade-in, $14.99/mo on your site, on Extra 2.0. i keep seeing this Next Up Anytime thing for +$10 a month where i can upgrade early up to 3 times a year, how much would my total monthly be with that added?
nice, so the $10 just gets added on top of everything else, yeah?
and do i have to pay off the 17 Pro first before i can upgrade, or does it roll over?
gotcha. that actually helps a lot, you made it way easier than i expected, thanks for being cool about all my nerdy questions.
nah that's it, have a great one, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
